description: Cross-verification pairing matrix per check family (spec §17.4, issue #23). Two engines per run, chosen for technological distance; never two instances of the same brick.

reachability.note: Tapaal × ITS-Tools; smpt as 3rd SMT differential for critical or discordant properties.

safety.note: Same pairing as reachability, plus dialect counter-variant (Reachability vs CTL) on one of the two.

liveness.note: Tapaal × ITS-Tools in CTLCardinality; TY as 3rd. LTL path semantics (GF φ) is a distinct examination, never merged with the CTL verdict.

recovery.note: Tapaal × ITS-Tools in CTLCardinality; TY as 3rd.

deadlock.note: GlobalProperties.ReachabilityDeadlock at 2 tools; random-walk probe is a fast unreliable detection, never alone in a contract.
